driver: common/driver.cu: gatherKthValue<float,int32_t,1><<<grid (1,1,1), block 1024, 0 dynamic shmem>>>(self_info{d_in, 1-D, size 1 after reduceDim, stride 1}, inputSliceSize=n, k, numInputSlices=1, inputWithinSliceStride=1, values_info, indices_info); args n k default 4096 5; prints kthvalue and index.
input: one slice of 4096 equal floats (0.0f), k=5 (1-based), block of 1024 threads, so every thread finds a match (torch.zeros(4096).cuda().kthvalue(5) equivalent). Thread-level access estimate (about 9e4, bound 2e5): radixSelect makes 16 passes (RADIX_BITS=2, 32-bit) of 4096 global loads each (6.6e4) plus ~260 shared accesses per pass (~4e3), findPattern 4096 loads, then 1024 loads + 2048 stores in the index search/write section; fixed variant adds 1024 shared loads and up to 1024 shared atomics.
notes: Smoke on c38 (sm_75, debugging only, never a result): buggy rc=0 printed 'gatherKthValue<float,int,1> n=4096 k=5 grid=1 block=1024 kthvalue=0 index=208 (valid value: yes; index == 0: no)' (the race MANIFESTED: index is the arbitrary last writer, not the smallest match); fixed rc=0 printed '... kthvalue=0 index=0 (valid value: yes; index == 0: yes)'. The buggy variant's stdout may differ between runs (outputs_differ expected in the native phase), the fixed variant's does not. The fixed variant has a shared-memory residual (plain LDS of minIndexFound at Sorting.cu:77 vs the atomicMin at :86), see the oracle; T_RACECHECK is na because the buggy race is global. Fatbin also holds the other dtype/index/dim instantiations of gatherKthValue/gatherMedian (instantiated by the unused host dispatchers); T_KERNEL=gatherKthValue matches all kth-value instantiations, only <float,int,1> is launched. Compile time ~35 s per variant. With the all-equal input, findPattern (SortingRadixSelect.cuh, verbatim, same blob in both revisions) has every matching thread write smem[0]/smem[1] with identical values (benign shared WAW) in BOTH variants; a shared-memory detector may report it, it is not the target pair.
